name: Colombia Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified): 253 closures (all named), no early closes and no one-off closures (exchange_calendars has none for XBOG). exchange_calendars closes 31 December every year (BVC's year-end non-trading day) and moves the Monday holidays as the registry does for 2025-2029. No holiday in the 2010-2024 set postdates its creating law (the Monday-moved holidays follow Law 51 of 1983), so nothing was removed; Colombian law was not re-read in 4c10. 2025-2026: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2027-2029: standing pattern. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c10). Last published year: BVC's own calendar (https://www.bvc.com.co/calendario) and trading-hours pages could not be fetched from this sandbox (not reachable; searches return only press and aggregators), so the 2025-2026 entries were not compared again and the span's first day is marked unconfirmed. Hours (lead, not changed): BVC moves its equity session with New York daylight saving time. Press reports (Valora Analitik, 27 February 2026; El Heraldo, 12 March 2018) give 8:30-15:00 Bogota time while New York is on EDT and 9:30-16:00 while it is on EST, with a closing auction that ends at a random time (2:55-3:00pm in 2018's EDT schedule). exchange_calendars models this as 9:30-16:00 America/New_York. The registry's single 09:30-15:00 America/Bogota mixes the two schedules (the EST open with the EDT close). It is kept as one dated entry from 2010-01-01, marked unconfirmed, because no BVC document was read; the fix (an America/New_York session or seasonal dated entries) is a modelling decision left for the maintainer.
